entries.title: Psalms 121:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> My eyes are lifted up to the hills: O where will my help come from?

entries.title: Psalms 121:2
segments: Your help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 121:3
segments: May he not let your foot be moved: no need of sleep has he who keeps you.

entries.title: Psalms 121:4
segments: See, the eyes of Israel's keeper will not be shut in sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 121:5
segments: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 121:6
segments: You will not be touched by the sun in the day, or by the moon at night.

entries.title: Psalms 121:7
segments: The Lord will keep you safe from all evil; he will take care of your soul.

entries.title: Psalms 121:8
segments: The Lord will keep watch over your going out and your coming in, from this time and for ever.
